# ValuRight.ai
> ValuRight.ai is exit-planning and business valuation software for Main Street small-business owners 55+. It gives a free planning range, a Health Score, and what-if scenarios using seven valuation methods. It is a planning estimate, not a certified appraisal.

## Start here
- [What is my business worth?](https://valuright.ai/what-is-my-business-worth): free planning range (Free Preview)
- [Methodology](https://valuright.ai/methodology): the seven methods, inputs, limits
- [Pricing](https://valuright.ai/pricing): Free Preview $0, Essentials $99/month, Exit Ready $249/month
